title: Stock market today: Dow and S&P 500 futures muted ahead of CPI data, Nasdaq rises

title: Taiwan's Foxconn reports 35% rise in Q2 profit on AI demand, beats forecasts
title_zh: 台湾富士康报告称，人工智能需求推动第二季度利润增长 35%，超出预期
summary: Taiwan's Foxconn, the world's largest contract electronics maker, reported on Wednesday a 35% rise in second-quarter profit, beating analyst forecasts, on continued strong demand for AI, which it predicted would drive ‌growth this year.
summary_zh: 全球最大的合同电子产品制造商台湾富士康周三报告称，由于对人工智能的持续强劲需求，第二季度利润增长了 35%，超出了分析师的预期，预计人工智能将推动今年的增长。

title: Intel's huge rally is helping pay for its AI comeback
title_zh: 英特尔的大幅上涨为其人工智能卷土重来提供了资金
summary: In today's Chart of the Day, Yahoo Finance Markets & Data Editor Jared Blikre dives into Intel's (INTC) rally and how the chipmaker’s surging stock price saved the company millions as it prepares to issue $20 billion in new common stock.
summary_zh: 在今天的每日图表中，雅虎财经市场和数据编辑 Jared Blikre 深入探讨了英特尔 (INTC) 的涨势，以及这家芯片制造商在准备发行 200 亿美元新普通股之际，股价飙升如何为该公司节省了数百万美元。

title: Can SpaceX really reach $100B in annual recurring revenue by 2027?
title_zh: 到 2027 年，SpaceX 的年度经常性收入真的能达到 100B 美元吗？
summary: Deutsche Bank predicts that SpaceX (SPCX) will hit $100 billion in annual recurring revenue (ARR) by the end of 2026. Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferré and PNC Asset Management Group chief investment officer Amanda Agati share their thoughts.
summary_zh: 德意志银行预测，到 2026 年底，SpaceX (SPCX) 的年度经常性收入 (ARR) 将达到 1000 亿美元。雅虎财经高级商业记者 Ines Ferré 和 PNC 资产管理集团首席投资官 Amanda Agati 分享了他们的想法。
